gold_note: Coelurosaur summary tree, root at the bottom. Coelurosauria, Paraves, Deinonychosauria, Dromaeosauridae and Eudromaeosauria (printed hyphenated over two lines, 'Eudromae-osauria'), each beside its node, are kept as internal labels. One three-way node: Achillobator, Utahraptor and Yurgovuchia. The symbols on branches are characters, not nodes. 15 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children); 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
